title: frame: dissect all OPT_PKT_ only if it's a REC_TYPE_PACKET.
description:
The OPT_ values correspond to pcapng option codes, meanning that the
same numerical value may correspond to different options in different
blocks, so if the record isn't a REC_TYPE_PACKET record, a given
OPT_PKT_ value may correspond to some other option.
